The laboratory-level rows (ECT_LAB_*) reproduce the pattern of size_gate.json on fresh draws; they are descriptive under D3.

emp_P1 is a skewed null built from seen corpus family ratios (13 of 14 DGA); it assumes new chemotypes resemble corpus units, which the supply does not (P4: 15 of 16 new laboratories on absent chemotypes).
